_comment: Verified config format from github.com/cockroachdb/claude-plugin for connecting Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code to the CockroachDB Cloud Managed MCP Server via a service-account API key (recommended for agent/automated use over interactive OAuth). Copy this to mcp_config.json, fill in the placeholders (cluster id from `ccloud cluster list`, API key from `ccloud service-account api-key create` — see ops/ccloud/provision_cluster.sh), and merge into your MCP client's config (e.g. .mcp.json for Claude Code). Read-only by default; write access requires explicit consent in the Cloud Console.
